results.controlIntent: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to: a. Carry out configuration management during system, component, or service [Selection (one or more): design; development; implementation; operation; disposal]; b. Document, manage, and control the integrity of changes to [Assignment: organization-defined configuration items under configuration management]; c. Implement only organization-approved changes to the system, component, or service; d. Document approved changes to the system, component, or service and the potential security and privacy impacts of such changes; and e. Track security flaws and flaw resolution within the system, component, or service and report findings to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel].

judgment.rationale:
Evidence from two sources reveals two distinct change-control violations against SA-10.v1:

**Violation 1 — Initial Deployment (CreateEndpoint):** The CloudTrail record (eca4cdbd) shows the endpoint was created on 2025-12-01 by user `data-scientist-jdoe`. The embedded evidence annotation explicitly flags that this deployment occurred approximately 2 hours *before* the registry approval (which was recorded at 2025-12-01T09:00Z per the registry entry 9aa502ce). This means the model was deployed into production before an organization-approved change was formally recorded — violating SA-10(c): "Implement only organization-approved changes."

**Violation 2 — Hotfix Deployment (UpdateEndpoint):** The CloudTrail record (47029602) shows a subsequent endpoint update on 2026-03-15 using config `churn-predictor-v1-hotfix`. The evidence note confirms there is no corresponding registry entry for this change. The model registry (9aa502ce) contains only version 1 with no hotfix approval. This means a configuration change was pushed to production with no documented approval, violating SA-10(b) (manage and control integrity of changes), SA-10(c) (only approved changes), and SA-10(d) (document approved changes and their security/privacy impacts).

Together, these two events demonstrate a pattern of changes being deployed outside the approved change-control process. There is no evidence of security/privacy impact documentation for either change, and no evidence of flaw tracking or reporting (SA-10(e)).
gaps: Security and privacy impact documentation for either deployment event — not present in CloudTrail or registry evidence
Flaw tracking records (e.g., issue tracker, security findings log) — no tool available to retrieve these
Approval workflow audit trail (e.g., who approved the registry entry and under what authority) — only approval timestamp is available, not the approver identity or rationale
Evidence of whether the hotfix config 'churn-predictor-v1-hotfix' was ever submitted for registry approval and rejected, or simply bypassed entirely
Human attestation from the model owner or change-control board regarding whether an out-of-band approval existed for either deployment
